title: ETs arrived en masse after the first atomic bomb

tellings.quote: after we detonated the first atomic bomb, the ETSs came in on force in mass

plain: Extraterrestrials began arriving on Earth in large numbers right after the first atomic bomb went off in 1945, says the UFO activist Steven Greer. He tells Michels, without naming a source, that after that test "the ETs came in in force, en masse." If true, it would mean beings from elsewhere took notice of humanity because we had gained nuclear weapons.
